items.title: Evernorth agrees conditional equity facility worth approximately $80 million
items.excerpt: Evernorth announced a committed equity purchase facility; the headline value is conditional, not capital already received.
items.why_it_matters: Track share dilution, pricing and whether additional XRP per share outweighs issuance effects.

items.title: Evernorth Form 8-K documents conditional equity purchase agreement
items.excerpt: The filing describes an equity purchase arrangement and associated terms.
items.why_it_matters: Review legally binding terms, issuance limits and actual outstanding share count.

items.title: Ripple Treasury introduces an always-on corporate treasury platform
items.excerpt: Ripple introduced enterprise treasury functionality covering cash operations and digital payment rails.
items.why_it_matters: Watch customer adoption, actual revenue and any demonstrated XRP demand rather than assuming they follow from launch.
